description: Verdicts of people who checked a place where NISAR and Sentinel-1 give a community different statuses (exam report, section NISAR and Sentinel-1). verdict: nisar (NISAR was right), sentinel1 (Sentinel-1 was right), undecidable. cause: optional, the zone type if the report got it wrong.

reviews.note: Channel clear and over 100 m wide on Sentinel-1 (10 m). On Sentinel-2 a cloud cuts the channel right at that point, but it is also over 100 m wide.
Sentinel-2 cloudy on 11 Oct around Santa Luzia do Catuiri. Near Vila Siao, on 4 Nov, Sentinel-2 clouds cut the link to Lake Tefe while Sentinel-1 (10 m) shows it clearly, over 100 m wide.

The point between Sao Jose and Parauari lies by the Solimoes, over 1 km wide at its narrowest. Across from Assuncao (Jaquiri) the side channel is about 40 m at its narrowest on Sentinel-1 (10 m) and Sentinel-2, but Jaquiri is less than 1 km from the Solimoes and should count as connected.
The point is inside Lake Tefe, far from the shore: open water (Sentinel-1 reads it about -15.5 dB on 4 Nov, wind).

Sentinel-2 all cloud that day. The Sentinel-1 (10 m) image is cut right there (scene edge) and leaves a loose piece of river; the channel is at least 100 m wide and continuous, and complete on the 40 m Sentinel-1 image.
Clear link over 100 m wide on Sentinel-1 (10 m); a Sentinel-2 cloud cuts the channel.
